chapterInfo.content:
1
Aweretɔ ne adom Nyankopɔn
1Elkosini Nahum adehunu nwoma a ɛfa Ninewe atemmuo ho.
2 # Eks 20.5; Deut 4.24 Onyankopɔn yɛ ninkufoɔ, AWURADE ne weretɔfoɔ.
Ampa ara, AWURADE tɔ were, na abufuo tumi hyɛ no ma.
AWURADE tɔ n’ahohiahiafoɔ so were,
na n’abufuo wɔ hɔ ma n’atamfo.
3 # Eks 34.7 AWURADE bo kyɛre fu, na n’ahoɔden so,
na ɔremmu fɔdifoɔ bem ara da.
AWURADE no, ahum ne kyinhyia mframa mu na ne kwan wɔ,
na mununkum yɛ ne nan ase mfuturo.
4Ɔteatea ɛpo ma no we,
na ɔma nsutene nyinaa mem;
Basan ne Karmel twintwam,
Lebanon nhwiren nso twintwam;
5 # Dwom 97.5 mmepɔ woso n’anim,
na nkokoɔ hono;
asase woso n’anim,
aane wiase ne wɔn a ɛte mu nyinaa mpo.
6Hwan na ɔbɛgyina n’abohuro anim,
na hwan na ɔbɛsɔre atia n’abufuo no?
N’anibereɛ hwie sɛ ogya,
na abotan bubu n’anim.
7 # Deut 4.31; Dwom 1.6 AWURADE yɛ,
ɔyɛ dwanekɔbea hiada mu,
na ɔnim wɔn a wɔdwane kɔtoa no.
8Na n’atamfo deɛ
ɔde nsuo a ayiri sram soɔ bɛma wɔn sibea ayera,
na wati wɔn akɔduru esum mu.
9Atamfoɔ, ɛdeɛn na modwene no AWURADE ho?
Ɔbɛwie mo korakora,
morensɔre ntia no mprenu.
10Na sɛ motoatoam sɛ nwerɛ na mo nsaden nso abobo mo mpo a, mobɛhye koraa
sɛ nkyɛnkyɛmma dwaneeɛ.
11Ninewe, wo mu na
deɛ ɔdwene AWURADE ho bɔne,
deɛ ɔtuu agyina huhuo no fire.
12Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Sɛ mo ho yɛ den na wɔdɔɔso saa mpo a,
wɔbɛtwitwa mo agu na moatwam akɔ.
Ao Yuda, sɛ mebrɛɛ wo ase mpo a,
afei deɛ meremmrɛ wo ase bio;
13na afei mɛbubu Ninewe kɔnnua afiri wo so,
na matete wo nkyehoma mu.
14Na wo Ninewe, AWURADE ahyɛ wo ho mmara sɛ,
wo din bɛyera afiri asase so.
Mɛtwitwa ohoni a wɔasene ne oguo honi
afiri wo nyame fie;
mɛbɔ wo damena, ɛfiri sɛ woadane ayɛ atantanneɛ.
15 # Yes 52.7; Nah 1.11 Hwɛ, mmepɔ so na
asɛmpakafoɔ nan wɔ,
wɔreka asomdwoeɛsɛm!
Yuda, di wo nnapɔnna,
ma w’aboadeɛ,
na ohuhuni no remfa wo mu bio,
wɔatwa no atwene koraa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
